text: At the Swansea Town Hall Association Annual General Meeting on May 16, 2019, the membership nominated the individuals listed above for appointment by Etobicoke York Community Council to the Board of Management of the Swansea Town Hall Community Centre. Appointments to the Swansea Town Hall Community Centre Board of Management is a matter for which the Community Council has been delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision, provided that the recommendations do not vary from the Public Appointments Policy. All the nominees are eligible and qualified to serve on the Board of Management pursuant to the relevant provisions of the City of Toronto By-law (Chapter 25 of the former City of Toronto Municipal Code), the Relationship Framework for Board run Community Centers and the Public Appointments Policy. By this letter, the Board of Management requests that all individuals…

The Toronto and East York Community Council appointed the following nominees: 1. For a 2-year term ending on May 31, 2021, and until successors are appointed: Phil Vlach Glenn Dunphy Ayan Kailie Liz Nadeau Justine Montgomery 2. For a 1-year term ending May 31 2020, and until a successor is appointed: Kosta Roumanis
